lead.what: Every US bomber at RAF Fairford flew to home stations on Sunday. At least 10 of 12 B-1s flew out, including some that had arrived within the week.

rest.what: Flávio Bolsonaro 47.03%, Lula 45.16%, both short of 50%. The first-round count is essentially complete.

lead.what: The 25 October runoff is the next print. Foreman puts Flávio at 58%; Tinkerton dissents at 0.48.

rest.what: Lessons are halted fully or partly at 400 to 500 high schools after security conditions went unmet.

lead.what: Southern Command directed a 4 October strike that killed four and offered no public drug evidence. Boat-strike deaths stand at 235 across 70 strikes.

rest.what: Dodik declared the sweep from Banja Luka while the count was still open. Turnout was 42% of 3,414,364 eligible.

props.title: The Tape
props.kicker: 5 Oct · bombers home, lycées halted, runoff set

items.what: Flávio Bolsonaro either wins the Brazilian runoff or Lula holds the presidency.
